resolved.title: if - else if语句
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]The if-else if Statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

When a decision among three or more actions is needed, the [b]if-else if[/b] statement can be used.
There can be multiple [b]else if[/b] clauses and the last [b]else [/b]clause is optional.
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="c" codeId="1642"]int score = 89;
  
[b]if [/b](score >= 90)
  printf("%s", "Top 10%\n");
[b]else if[/b] (score >= 80)
  printf("%s", "Top 20%\n");
[b]else if[/b] (score > 75)
  printf("%s", "You passed.\n");
[b]else[/b]
  printf("%s", "You did not pass.\n"); [/code]
Carefully consider the logic involved when developing an [b]if-else if [/b]statement. Program flow branches to the statements associated with the first true expression and none of the remaining expressions will be tested.
Although indents won't affect the compiled code, the logic of the [b]if-else if[/b] will be easier to understand by a reader when the [b]else [/b]clauses are aligned.
[note]When possible, an [b]if-else if[/b] statement is preferred over nested if statements for clarity. [/note]

在编写一个**if-else if**语句时，要仔细考虑其中的逻辑。程序逐个检测每个分支，并执行第一个表达式为真的语句，其余的表达式都不会被测试。

尽管缩进不会影响编译后的代码，但当**else**语句对齐时，**if-else if**的逻辑更易阅读理解。
